page_title: HAV 1-2 REI | Le Havre v Reims 25/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Florent Batta is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' 1 - 2 Goal! Mohamed Daramy (Reims) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mathieu Gorgelin into the bottom right corner.
90+6' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+6' Reims will get another bite of the cherry as the referee indicates the penalty must be taken again!
90+6' Mathieu Gorgelin (Le Havre) is punished with the yellow card.
90+4' Junya Ito (Reims) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the middle of the goal, but only into the gloves of a well-prepared Mathieu Gorgelin.
90+4' Junya Ito (Reims) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+4' It's like he was asking for a caution. Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) receives a yellow card.
90+3' It’s a PENALTY to Reims after the VAR review!
90+2' Referee Florent Batta makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Reims. Let’s see what happens!
90+1' One of the Reims players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Amir Richardson (Reims) wins the battle with the defender and plants a header goalwards from the corner, but his effort from around the penalty spot sails harmlessly past the right post.
89' The referee blows his whistle, Le Havre are awarded a corner kick.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Le Havre.
85' Mohamed Bayo will be replaced by Steve Ngoura (Le Havre).
85' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
83' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Reims.
79' Will Still has decided to make a change. Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) replaces Oumar Diakite.
75' Here comes a substitution. Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is brought on as a substitute for Loic Nego.
74' Loic Nego (Le Havre) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
74' 1 - 1 Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Yehvann Diouf to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
74' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is going to take the penalty!
73' Thibault De Smet (Reims) is given a yellow card.
73' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Le Havre!
72' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Le Havre! Let's see what he decides.
71' PENALTY APPEAL by Le Havre, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
70' It is time for a substitution. Therence Koudou (Reims) is on for Reda Khadra.
66' Thomas Foket (Reims) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Florent Batta shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
66' Referee Florent Batta points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Reims players.
66' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Reims goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
64' 0 - 1 Goal! Reda Khadra tees up Mohamed Daramy (Reims) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 0:1.
63' Will Still prepares a substitution. Teddy Teuma is replaced by Amir Richardson (Reims).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Keito Nakamura departs the field of play to be replaced by Mohamed Daramy (Reims).
60' One of the players from Reims times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

59' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the right post.
57' Loic Nego (Le Havre) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
57' Reims take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

56' A tremendous drive by Oumar Diakite (Reims) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Mathieu Gorgelin makes a brilliant save. The linesman makes the right call and Reims will have a corner.
52' Reims have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
51' What a chance! The ball is inside the box and Oumar Diakite (Reims) takes a first-time shot on goal, but his volley goes narrowly wide of the right post.
49' Keito Nakamura (Reims) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
48' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) whips a volley from long range towards the goal. His beautiful effort whistles wide of the left post.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Florent Batta has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' The cross fools the defence and leaves Oumar Diakite (Reims) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the left post.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

40' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
38' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the middle of the goal. Yehvann Diouf is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
36' Loic Nego (Le Havre) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
32' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
30' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Reims was in an offside position.
28' The corner is swung in but Le Havre can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

27' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Le Havre can continue in their attacking effort.
24' The referee Florent Batta awards Thomas Foket (Reims) a yellow card.
23' Reims failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
22' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Reims, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Reims.
19' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but Yehvann Diouf comes off his line to gather the ball.
16' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Reda Khadra (Reims) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

12' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
12' The linesman points to the corner flag, Le Havre are going to take it.
11' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) is penalised for holding. Florent Batta signals a set piece.
11' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) meets an accurate cross in the box and steers a fine header towards the net. The goalkeeper has to react quickly to keep the ball out.
10' Le Havre work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Reda Khadra (Reims) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Le Havre are awarded the free kick.
4' Reims couldn't find the way to score from a close-range free kick as Mathieu Gorgelin (Le Havre) leaped high and intercepted the cross.

3' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Florent Batta stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Reims have been awarded a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Le Havre will have the kick-off.
Florent Batta is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
